full_prompt_en: A square painterly digital landscape shows two small walkers descending a narrow track through tall meadow grass in late afternoon. The view begins within a shaded foreground enclosure: dark tree trunks rise on both sides, branching foliage crosses the upper corners, and clusters of deep brown stems and seed heads fill the lower edge. Between those dark borders, the footpath curves from the lower center toward the middle distance. The two people are simple dark silhouettes, one shorter and one taller, walking away into the luminous field. Long grasses on the sloping ground catch bright honey-yellow light along their tips, while the shaded sides remain umber and olive brown. A rounded shrub stands beyond the walkers, and softly layered hilltops and tree masses recede through amber haze. The sky at the top is a pale, warm gold with no hard cloud outlines. The image feels painted in small broken strokes and blended masses: individual grasses flicker as thin marks, while distant foliage becomes velvety blocks with softened boundaries. Strong low sunlight pours through the opening between trees, creating a glowing band across the meadow and gentle shafts in the mist. The foreground shadows have depth but little sharp detail, making the bright winding route the main visual guide. Warm gold occupies most of the center, framed by dark brown verticals and softened orange distance. The whole scene draws attention from an intimate shadowed threshold into a spacious, quiet landscape bathed in golden-hour light.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画感数字风景描绘两个小小的行人，在傍晚沿窄径走下长草覆盖的草坡。视线从阴影中的前景围合处开始：深暗树干立在两边，树冠穿过上角，深棕色茎叶和草籽穗丛填满下缘。暗色边框之间，小径从下方中央弯向中景。两个人被简化为深色剪影，一高一矮，背对观者走进明亮草地。坡面长草的尖端接住明亮蜂蜜黄色光，背光侧仍是赭棕与橄榄棕。行人后方立着一团圆灌木，更远处层层丘顶和树林在琥珀薄雾中退去。上方天空是淡暖金色，没有清晰的云轮廓。画面像由细碎断笔和融和色块绘成：单株草闪成细线，远处树叶则化为边界柔软的绒面色块。低角度强阳光从树间缺口倾入，在草地上形成一道发光带，也在雾里形成轻微光束。前景阴影有深度却少锐利细节，使明亮蜿蜒的路线成为主要导向。暖金占据中央大部，由深棕竖线与柔化橙色远景围住。整幅图引导视线从贴近的阴暗门槛走进沐浴在黄金时刻光线里的开阔宁静风景。
style_prompt_en: Painterly digital landscape rendering builds depth through a strong warm-light gradient rather than intricate outlines. Dark umber foreground framing, fine grass strokes, and small glints lead into wide honey-gold middle values, then dissolve into pale amber distance. Broken marks describe close vegetation, while distant wooded forms merge into soft layered masses. Low raking sunlight catches edges and cuts a luminous path through darker surroundings; gentle haze diffuses the far hills. The palette stays within gold, ochre, olive brown, and soft orange, with only restrained near-black anchors. A shaded threshold around a bright open center creates inviting depth and a slow, quiet visual rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画感数字风景通过强烈的暖光渐层建立深度，而不依赖繁密轮廓。深赭前景框景、细草笔触和微小亮点导入宽阔蜂蜜金色中间调，再融进浅琥珀远景。断续笔痕描绘近处植物，远方树林则并入柔软分层色块。低角度斜射阳光勾亮边缘，在暗色周围开出发光道路；轻雾漫散远山。调色限于金色、赭黄、橄榄棕与柔橙，以少量近黑稳住画面。环绕明亮开放中心的阴影门槛制造亲近的纵深和舒缓安静的视觉节奏。
theme_en: Two distant walkers crossing a sunlit meadow toward hazy hills
theme_zh: 两个远处行人穿过阳光草坡走向朦胧丘陵
name: Golden hour
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
